text: Postgres Row Level Security provides granular authorization rules enforced inside the database
quote: Postgres Row Level Security (RLS) gives you granular authorization rules that run inside the database.

text: RLS policies can restrict rows to the authenticated user, e.g. users viewing only their own todos
quote:
create policy "Individuals can view their own todos."
on todos for select
to authenticated
using ( (select auth.uid()) = user_id );
